A '''planetary police''' was in operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xerxes]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], fell afoul of the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]], and was wanted by them during his visit to the world.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
